title: Generated Chat operations refuse fingerprint guests before transport
surface: Chat queue controls and delegated tool continuation
role_org_permissions: Guests carry fingerprint only; signed-in requests require explicit organization
preconditions: Current source f87e5d2fb includes generated-operation migration; lockfile resolves @ai-matrx/api 0.1.10.
reproduction: A signed-out install calls enqueueInboxMessage, cancelRequest, editInboxMessage, cancelInboxMessage or postToolResults.

Generated guest-tier operation declares organization required. createApi.organizationFor calls requireOrganizationContext before credentials are read; runOp retries via requireActiveOrganizationId and returns STATUS_NO_ORGANIZATION without fetch.
expected: Guest operations reach transport with X-Fingerprint-ID and no fabricated organization; authenticated operations carry explicit X-Organization-Id.
actual: The migration source refused before transport because the generated descriptors required an organization for fingerprint guests. The restoration is covered by exact-source CI, including 21/21 guest-chat transport assertions. Native guest acceptance on the resulting 0.2.509 artifact remains unverified: the first driver stopped before browser launch because Playwright was unavailable, and the corrected run was refused at resource pressure level 2; no assistant reply was observed.
cause: Generated org-required descriptor is enforced independently of credential kind; the server-owned guest organization funnel cannot be reached.
sibling_census: Restored seven operations together: enqueue, cancel run, list inbox, edit inbox, cancel inbox, submit tool results, list pending calls. Stream first-send/continue/resume still uses existing stream path and requires native surrounding retest. Exact import-to-published-descriptor census also finds guest+org-required descriptors used by capture-ladder, prospects, sources, PDF extraction, research, Google Gmail send, and file upload/download. Their host guest eligibility is not established; parent owns follow-up census rather than expanding this Chat restoration without evidence.
severity: S1: public guest Chat follow-up/control/delegated continuation regression
evidence: Published npm @ai-matrx/api 0.1.10 tarball dist/chunk-FLANGLCG.js lines 1145-1155: org required before sendOnWire credentials. Its changelog adds types only; guest descriptors still org required.
